EmailTemplate.subject: Finding The Right Patient Payments Partner In Healthcare
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
It isn’t easy. A lot of patient billing and payment partners say that they do the same thing, so distinguishing between them at first (and even second or third) glance can be difficult. Do they all really have the most sophisticated technology, a proven track record of client success, and a streamlined implementation process? Can they all really make the patient experience that much better? When pressed, you quickly find that the answer is no.
In a recent webinar, Flywire sat down with two leading consulting firms that help health systems choose the right technology partners for their needs to discuss all things around digital transformation in patient billing and vendor selection.
Watch a short clip <https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-the-consumer-revolution-has-been-digitized-how-to-meet-patients-where-they-are-online?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email> with their advice on how to cut through the clutter and find the right partner for your organization.
Best, The Flywire Team
